statement: For pure transverse modes k,l and polarizations a,b, the symmetric quadratic direction is P_(k+l)[(a.l)b+(b.k)a], up to i*2pi; real phase combinations isolate sum/difference and each pure shear has zero self-interaction. Nonparallel unequal-length parents with full transverse planes span (k+l)-perp: out-of-plane cross-product polarization and an independent in-plane coefficient proportional to |k|^2-|l|^2. Repeated nonparallel unequal-length unit increments from diagonals generate any fixed finite Fourier list, with finite rational linear algebra.
